name: alibaba-cn
description: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope China) via its OpenAI-compatible API. Model context limits resolve from the alibaba-cn catalog, including third-party models hosted there (Kimi, DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax).
setup_steps: Sign in to https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/ and create an API key
Set the DASHSCOPE_API_KEY environment variable to the key
